step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify entities from the visual architecture diagram and transcript:
   - Manufacturing sites generating terabytes of data daily (`TB/d` -> ThirdParty)
   - AWS IoT Core (`IOT` -> IoTCore) collecting data from on-site software agents
   - Amazon Kinesis (`KINESIS` -> Kinesis) streaming high-volume data
   - AWS Lambda (`LAMBDA` -> Lambda) validating, enriching, and formatting records
   - Amazon OpenSearch / Elasticsearch (`ES` -> OpenSearch) for real-time visualization
   - Amazon DynamoDB (`DYNAMODB` -> DynamoDB) for persistent state storage
   - Amazon S3 (`S3` -> S3) storing raw JSON data lake files and optimized Parquet datasets
   - AWS Glue (`GLUE` -> Glue) running batch ETL conversions from JSON to Parquet
   - Amazon Athena (`ATHENA` -> Athena) performing SQL queries over Parquet data in S3 via Glue catalog
   - Amazon API Gateway (`API GW` -> ApiGateway) exposing query endpoints to dashboards
   - End User (`User` -> UserConsumerWeb) accessing real-time and batch dashboards
2. Trace and define flows:
   - Flow 0: Manufacturing site agents ingest data into IoT Core, which streams to Kinesis. Lambda processes Kinesis data, concurrently writing near real-time insights to OpenSearch, persistent records to DynamoDB, and raw JSON files to S3.
   - Flow 1: Glue transforms S3 raw JSON files into optimized Parquet files. Athena queries this data using Glue schema catalog, presenting query results through API Gateway to the end user.

edges.notes: Software agents on site transmit local manufacturing data to IoT Core.
IoT Core forwards ingested data stream to Kinesis.
Kinesis streams high-volume data to Lambda for processing.
Lambda writes enriched near real-time records into OpenSearch.
Lambda writes persistent record state into DynamoDB.
Lambda saves raw incoming JSON files to S3.
Glue transforms JSON files into binary Parquet format back in S3.
Glue catalog provides schema definitions used by Athena.
Athena query results are exposed via API Gateway.
Users interact with dashboards via API Gateway endpoints.
